content.text: class Ia, Ic or III drugs can convert AF to sinus rhythm; except amiodarone and sotalol, which also slow the rate, don't use them until the rate is controlled; oral forms also maintain sinus rhythm (amiodarone most effective, but more adverse events). In flutter, class Ia/Ic can allow 1:1 conduction, so control the rate first with BB or non-DHP CCB.
